## TL;DR
Merged current main into the task branch and fixed the duplicate `httpDiscovery` properties in `src/ui-app/tests/servers-command.test.ts` that caused TS1117 during the close-out build. The current tree passes `repoos check`.

## Work and rationale
Main had added a shared `noHttpDiscovery` helper to several server-command tests while this branch already had inline `httpDiscovery: async () => null` stubs in those same test objects. The merge exposed both properties in six object literals. I kept one deterministic discovery stub in each affected test. I resolved the task-file merge conflict by taking main's copy, as required by the repository workflow, and completed the merge in commit `7417f02d0b28f3b6ca1b59121bdbbece6e320578`.

## Approaches tried
I inspected the compiler-reported test file, confirmed the duplicate keys were the overlapping HTTP-discovery stubs, merged main, and removed the redundant inline entries while preserving the shared helper. I then ran the full `repoos check` against the merge commit.

## Challenges and blockers
The check passed: the remote build succeeded, all 753 test files passed (10,073 tests passed and 14 skipped), and remote UI smoke and rendered contrast passed. Local staleness rebuild, formatting, lint, build, safety guards, UI smoke, user-docs build, Telegram build and tests, and macOS Hub icon transparency also passed. Signed-in Projects and Tasks remain human follow-up #1174 and are not claimed as verified.

## Key learnings
When main adds a shared test stub that overlaps with branch-local inline stubs, resolving the merge requires removing duplicate object keys while keeping the deterministic dependency seam. The merge-gate build caught this even though the prior review had passed.
